g.text: 24 matched tasks per setup · stock Jev command preselection ON / OFF
Success = correct reference-task outcome. All attempts count; this is a synthetic source replay, not a live Wingman benchmark.
Command-only median: Haiku 0.99 → 0.57 s | Qwen 0.38 → 0.32 s
SUPPORT JOBS — CONDITIONAL / BACKGROUND, SHOWN SEPARATELY
Context preserved: Haiku 8/8 · 1.59 s · $0.160 / 1,000 jobs* Qwen 3/8 · 0.54 s · $0 API fee
Best tested candidate: Haiku Main + Haiku Support. Stock Jev speeds command selection; no accuracy change in this controlled replay.
Deployment caveat: stock Support has no direct Anthropic BYOK selector. The Wingman-hosted Support baseline is not identified or measured.
¹ Median across all 24 trials; Jev-ON time composes recorded stages. Commands end at intent/proposal, excluding acknowledgement, game action and audio.
² Foreground API cost per 1,000 copies of this 24-task mix; excludes conditional Support jobs, acknowledgement/TTS and local hardware/electricity.
* Haiku = uncached token list-price estimate, not an invoice. Jev cost is provider-reported. Shared stages are replayed, not 192 independent live trials.
Models: Claude Haiku 5.5 compatible defaults · Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K-M, no thinking · stock Jev 1.14. No added Main helper or Support helper.
Local hardware: RTX 2080 Ti 11 GiB · Intel i7-10700K · 32 GiB RAM · llama.cpp b10964. API models remote. 2026-11-09 | Wingman 3.2.14 source.
